# Statistic: Describe projected increase in impact over time.
```{r}
## Change in global pressure
## global
tmp <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative", full=TRUE)
stack <- rast(tmp)
new_names <- gsub(".tif", "", basename(tmp))
names(stack) <- new_names

# paper statistics
global(stack, "sum", na.rm=TRUE)
1954814.9/893408.4
2325471.4/890850.4

#1958809.2/892389.5 ##ssp245
#2331685.3/889717.7 ##ssp585


## percent area with pressure >1 
ocean <- rast(here("_spatial/ocean_area_mol.tif"))
ocean <- ifel(ocean>0, 1, ocean)
ocean_area <- global(ocean, "sum", na.rm=TRUE)

stack_high <- ifel(stack >= 1, 1, NA)
high_spots <- global(stack_high, "sum", na.rm=TRUE)
high_spots <- data.frame(high_spots) %>%
  mutate(ocean_area = ocean_area) %>%
  mutate(ocean_percent = sum/ocean_area*100)


## global coast
coast <- rast(here("_spatial/coastal_country_mol.tif"))
coast <- ifel(coast>0, 1, 0)
coast_area <- global(coast, "sum", na.rm=TRUE)

stack_high <- ifel(stack >= 1, 1, NA)
coast_high_spots <- stack_high * coast
coast_high_spots <- data.frame(global(coast_high_spots, "sum", na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(coast_area = coast_area) %>%
  mutate(coast_percent = sum/coast_area*100)


```


## Vulnerability table (supplement)
```{r}

habitats <- read_csv(here("impact/habitat_list.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(file_name, plot_name_habitat)
pressures <- read_csv(here("impact/pressure_list.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(pressure, plot_name_pressure) %>%
  mutate(plot_name_pressure = ifelse(pressure == "sst-extremes", "ocean warming, surface", plot_name_pressure))  %>%
  mutate(plot_name_pressure = ifelse(pressure=="temperature-benthic", "ocean warming, benthic", plot_name_pressure)) %>%
 mutate(plot_name_pressure = ifelse(pressure == "oxygen-benthic", "reduced oxygen, benthic", plot_name_pressure)) %>%
        mutate(plot_name_pressure = ifelse(pressure == "oxygen-surface", "reduced oxygen, surface", plot_name_pressure))

vuln <- read_csv(here("impact/vulnerability_weighting_matrix.csv")) %>%
pivot_longer(
  cols = -pressure, 
  names_to = "file_name",
  values_to = "value"
) %>%
  mutate(value = round(value/4, 2)) %>%
  left_join(habitats) %>%
  left_join(pressures) %>%
  dplyr::select(pressure = plot_name_pressure, habitat=plot_name_habitat, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pressure,
              values_from = value)
  
write_csv(vuln, here("impact/data/vulnerability.csv"))

```

### Figure 1
Maps of cumulative impact and change in cumulative impact

Get land boundaries

```{r}

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
# Define the Mollweide projection string
moll_crs <- "+proj=moll"

# Reproject the world data to Mollweide
world_moll <- st_transform(world, crs = moll_crs)

```

Get current and future cumulative impacts
```{r}

upperscale <- 1.5
cols_palette <- paletteer_c("grDevices::Lajolla", 200)
#cols_palette <- rev(paletteer_c("ggthemes::Classic Orange-Blue", 250)[1:150])
#cols_palette <- paletteer_c("ggthemes::Temperature Diverging", 100)

tmp <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative", full=TRUE)
stack <- rast(tmp)
new_names <- gsub(".tif", "", basename(tmp))
names(stack) <- new_names

stack_capped <- ifel(stack>upperscale, upperscale, stack)

for(i in 1:dim(stack_capped)[3]){
#i=5
zlim_values <- c(0, upperscale)
raster_data <- stack_capped[[i]]
df <- as.data.frame(raster_data, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(df) <- c("x", "y", "value")

plot_cum <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = cols_palette,
    limits = zlim_values,
    name = ""
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_moll,
    fill = "gray80",       # Land fill color
    color = "gray85",      # Slightly lighter color for boundaries
    size = 0.2,            # Adjust line thickness
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
#  ggtitle(gsub(".tif", "", basename(tmp[i]))) +
geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = cols_palette,
    limits = zlim_values,
    name = ""
  ) +
    theme_minimal() +
theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks = element_blank(),
  axis.text = element_blank(),
  axis.title = element_blank(),
  legend.position = "right",
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
)


ggsave(plot_cum, filename=here(sprintf("impact/figs/cumulative/%s", gsub(".tif", ".png", basename(tmp[i])))), width=5.5, height = 2.5, units = c("in"))
}

```

Function to make global plot of change in impact figures. 
```{r}

cols_palette <- c(paletteer_c("grDevices::BluGrn", 30)[21:30],
                  colorRampPalette(c("#F5F5F5", "#FFFE9EFF"))(10),
                  rev(paletteer_c("grDevices::Inferno", 100)))
#library(colorspace)
#cols_all <- diverging_hcl("Red-Green", n=220)
#cols_palette <- c(cols_all[151:160], rev(cols_all[1:90]))

diff_impact <- function(raster, lowerscale = -0.1, upperscale = 1.1, saveName){
#raster=ssp2_med
# fileName = "test"
  raster_data = raster
raster_data <- ifel(raster_data>upperscale, upperscale, raster_data)
raster_data <- ifel(raster_data<lowerscale, lowerscale, raster_data)
zlim_values <- c(lowerscale, upperscale)
df <- as.data.frame(raster_data, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(df) <- c("x", "y", "value")

plot_cum <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = cols_palette,
    limits = zlim_values,
    name = ""
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_moll,
    fill = "gray80",       # Land fill color
    color = "gray85",      # Slightly lighter color for boundaries
    size = 0.2,            # Adjust line thickness
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) + 
   geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = cols_palette,
    limits = zlim_values,
    name = ""
  ) +
#  ggtitle(gsub(".tif", "", basename(tmp[i]))) +
  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks = element_blank(),
  axis.text = element_blank(),
  axis.title = element_blank(),
  legend.position = "right",
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
)

ggsave(plot_cum, filename=here(sprintf("impact/figs/cumulative/%s", saveName)), width=4.5, height = 2.5, units = c("in"))
}


list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative", full=TRUE)

            rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp245_current.tif") 
ssp5_med <- rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp585_medium-term.tif")- 
            rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp585_current.tif")
```

histogram and statistics for latitudinal patterns
```{r}

tmp <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative", full=TRUE, pattern = "current|medium-term")
stack <- rast(tmp)
new_names <- gsub(".tif", "", basename(tmp))
names(stack) <- new_names

global_df <- as.data.frame(stack, xy=TRUE) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("ssp"),  
    names_to = "scenario",      
    values_to = "value"         
  ) %>%
  group_by(y, scenario) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            sum_impact = sum(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(avg_impact = sum_impact/n) %>%
  dplyr::select(y, scenario, avg_impact) 


plot_data <- global_df %>%
  filter(scenario %in% c("ssp245_current", "ssp245_medium-term"))

hist <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = y, y = avg_impact, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_area(
    data = filter(plot_data, scenario == "ssp245_current"),
    aes(x = y, y = avg_impact, fill = "ssp245_current"),
    alpha = 0.5, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_area(
    data = filter(plot_data, scenario == "ssp245_medium-term"),
    aes(x = y, y = avg_impact, fill = "ssp245_medium-term"),
    alpha = 0.5, color = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("ssp245_current" = "blue", "ssp245_medium-term" = "red"),
    guide = "none"  # Remove legend
  ) +
  theme_void() +  # Removes all background, grids, and axis lines
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),    # Remove title
    axis.title = element_blank(),    # Remove axis titles
    axis.text = element_blank(),     # Remove axis text
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),    # Remove axis ticks
    panel.grid = element_blank(),    # Remove grid lines
    panel.border = element_blank()   # Remove border
  )

ggsave(hist, filename=here("impact/figs/latitudinal_impacts.png"), width=5.5, height =2, units = c("in"))

```

Global plot of hotspots
```{r}

ssp2_change <- rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp245_medium-term.tif") -
               rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp245_current.tif")
ssp2_change_high_quant <-global(ssp2_change, fun = quantile, probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE) %>% pull()
ssp2_change_high <- ifel(ssp2_change >= ssp2_change_high_quant, 1, 0)
ssp2_change_low_quant <-global(ssp2_change, fun = quantile, probs = 0.20, na.rm = TRUE) %>% pull()
ssp2_change_low <- ifel(ssp2_change <= ssp2_change_low_quant, 1, 0)

ssp2_current <- rast("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative/ssp245_current.tif")
ssp2_current_high_quant <-global(ssp2_current, fun = quantile, probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE) %>% pull()
ssp2_current_high <- ifel(ssp2_current >= ssp2_current_high_quant, 1, 0)
ssp2_current_low_quant <-global(ssp2_current, fun = quantile, probs = 0.20, na.rm = TRUE) %>% pull()
ssp2_current_low <- ifel(ssp2_current <= ssp2_current_low_quant, 1, 0)

# category 1: current low and stable
cat1 <- ssp2_current_low + ssp2_change_low
cat1 <- ifel(cat1 == 2, 3, NA)
plot(cat1, col="#26547C")

# category 2: current high and stable
cat2 <- ssp2_current_high + ssp2_change_low
cat2 <- ifel(cat2 == 2, 4, NA)
plot(cat2, col="#FDCFF3", add=TRUE)

# category 3: current low and fast increase
cat3 <- ssp2_current_low + ssp2_change_high
cat3 <- ifel(cat3 == 2, 4, NA)
plot(cat3, col="#FFD166", add=TRUE)


# category 4: current high and fast increase
cat4 <- ssp2_current_high + ssp2_change_high
cat4 <- ifel(cat4 == 2, 3, NA)
plot(cat4, col="#EF476F", add=TRUE)


png(here("impact/figs/hotspots.png"), width = 2000, height = 1500, res = 300)

plot(st_geometry(world_moll), col="gray80", border="gray85")
plot(cat1, col="#26547C", add=TRUE, legend=FALSE)
plot(cat2, col="#FDCFF3", add=TRUE, legend=FALSE)
plot(cat3, col="#FFD166", add=TRUE, legend=FALSE)
plot(cat4, col="#EF476F", add=TRUE, legend=FALSE)

dev.off()

```

Now get pressure impacts data together by summarizing pressure impacts across habitats.

```{r}
check <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/pressure_impacts/", full=TRUE)
file.remove(check)


# 1. summarize pressure rasters across habitats
summarize_pressures <- function(scenario ="ssp245", time = "medium-term"){
  # scenario = "ssp245"
  # time = "medium-term"
  
files <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/hab_vuln_pressure_habitat_corrected/", full=TRUE)

pressure_list <- data.frame(pressures=c("sst-extremes|temperature", "slr", "_oxygen-", "_oa_", "nutrient", "npp", "light-pollution", "fisheries", "coastal-disturbance", "air-heat-index"),
                            pressure_name = c("ocean-warming", "sea-level-rise", "reduced-oxygen", "acidification", "nutrient-pollution", "primary-productivity", "light-pollution",
                                              "fisheries-biomass-loss", "coastal-disturbance", "air-heat-index"))

  for(pressure in pressure_list$pressures){
    #pressure = pressure_list$pressures[9]
    pressure_files <- grep(scenario, files, value=TRUE)
    pressure_files <- grep(time, pressure_files, value=TRUE)
    pressure_files <- grep(pressure, pressure_files, value=TRUE)
    cat(pressure, "n = ", length(pressure_files), "\n")
    
    pressure_impact_rasts <- rast(pressure_files)
    pressure_impact_sum <- sum(pressure_impact_rasts, na.rm=TRUE)
   
    name_raster <- paste0(pressure_list$pressure_name[pressure_list$pressures==pressure],"_",
                          scenario, "_", time, ".tif")
    writeRaster(pressure_impact_sum, 
                paste0("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/pressure_impacts/", name_raster),
                overwrite=TRUE) 
  }
}

summarize_pressures(scenario ="ssp245", time = "medium-term")
summarize_pressures(scenario ="ssp245", time = "current")
summarize_pressures(scenario ="ssp585", time = "medium-term")
summarize_pressures(scenario ="ssp585", time = "current")

```

Now get the data for each pressure and plot by region
```{r}

list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/pressure_impacts/")

pressures <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/pressure_impacts/", full=TRUE, pattern="ssp245")
pressure_stack <- rast(pressures)
source_info <- gsub(".tif", "", basename(sources(pressure_stack)))
names(pressure_stack) <- source_info


offshore2 <- ifel(offshore>=1, 2, 0)
offshore2 <- ifel(is.na(offshore2), 0, offshore2)
coast2 <- ifel(is.na(coast), 0, coast)
habitats <- offshore2 + coast2
habitats <- ifel(habitats == 0, NA, habitats)

coast_area <- global(coast, "sum", na.rm=TRUE) %>% pull()
offshore_area <- global(offshore, "sum", na.rm=TRUE) %>% pull()

area_df <- data.frame(region = c("coastal", "offshore"),
                      area = c(coast_area, offshore_area))

  # Compute the average pressure impact for each region
  zonal_sum <- zonal(pressure_stack, habitats, fun = "sum", na.rm=TRUE)


avg_pressure_impacts <- zonal_sum %>%
 pivot_longer(cols=-ocean_area_mol, names_to = "pressure_impact", values_to="value") %>%
separate(
    col = pressure_impact,
    into = c("pressure", "scenario", "time_period"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(region = ifelse(ocean_area_mol == 1, "coastal", "offshore")) %>%
  mutate(pressure = gsub("-", " ", pressure)) %>%
  left_join(area_df, by="region") %>%
  mutate(pressure_impact = value/area) %>%
  dplyr::select(pressure, scenario, time_period, region, pressure_impact)

# Calculate average impact for each pressure
average_impacts <- avg_pressure_impacts %>%
  group_by(pressure) %>%
  summarize(avg_impact = mean(pressure_impact, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(avg_impact)


# Prepare data
df <- avg_pressure_impacts %>%
  mutate(
    pressure = factor(pressure, levels = average_impacts$pressure),
    region = factor(region), 
    time_period = factor(time_period, levels = c("current", "medium-term"))
  )

# Reshape data to wide format
df_wide <- df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(pressure, region),
    names_from = time_period,
    values_from = pressure_impact
  ) %>%
  arrange(pressure)

# Create combined factor and adjust positions
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    pressure_position = as.numeric(factor(pressure, levels = levels(df$pressure))),
    y_position = pressure_position + ifelse(region == "coastal", -0.1, 0.1),
    delta = `medium-term` - current,
    offset = delta * 0.05,  # Adjust this fraction as needed
    x_start = current + sign(delta) * offset,
    x_end = `medium-term` - sign(delta) * offset
  )


# Create the plot
coast_compare <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = df_wide,
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_end,
      y = y_position,

    ),

    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_wide,
    aes(x = `medium-term`, y = y_position, shape = "Medium-Term", color = region),

  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = unique(df_wide$pressure_position),
    labels = levels(df$pressure)
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "",  # Legend title
    values = c("Current" = 16, "Medium-Term" = 17),
    labels = c("Current" = "current", "Medium-Term" = "future")  # Customized labels
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "",

  theme_minimal() +

    title = "",

        #axis.title = element_blank(),

        legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),

    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"  )
```

```{r}

calc_start_end <- function(df, group = 'habitat', var = 'pressure', val = 'impact') {
  ordered_df <- df %>%
    ### flag negative vars
    mutate(neg = !!sym(val) < 0) %>%
    ### arrange by group (e.g., habitat, region) and by a particular variable (e.g., pressure)
    ### move negative values to the front by ordering by `neg` flag
    arrange(!!sym(group), -neg, !!sym(var))
  
  out_df <- ordered_df %>%
    group_by(!!sym(group)) %>%
    ### deal with negs by flipping to positive then nudging negative after
    ### first, set up temp variable to hold the value of interest; find the total
    ### negative contributions; then flip the values to positive if neg and do 
    ### cumulative sums; then nudge the entire cum sums by the total negative contributions
    mutate(tmp = !!sym(val),
           nudge = sum(tmp[tmp < 0]),
           tmp = ifelse(neg, -tmp, tmp),
           end = cumsum(tmp),
           start = lag(end, default = 0) + nudge,
           end = end + nudge) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-neg, -tmp, -nudge)
  
  return(out_df)
}
```

cumulative impact: country EEZ summaries (don't end up using this, go with coastal area instead)
```{r}

eez <- rast(here("_spatial/eez_mol_w_land.tif"))

ocean_cells<- rast(here("_spatial/ocean_area_mol.tif"))
ocean_area <- ifel(ocean_cells>0, 1, 0)


#get the area
eez <- eez*ocean_area
plot(eez)

eez_id <- read_csv(here("_spatial/eez_rgn_names/rgn_names_ohi.csv")) %>%
  filter(!(iso3c %in% "GUM")) # cut out duplicated dual region

impact_files <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative", full=TRUE)

impact_stack <- rast(impact_files)
source_info <- gsub(".tif", "", basename(sources(impact_stack)))
names(impact_stack) <- source_info

result_list <- list()

# Loop through each layer in the cumulative stack
for (i in 1:nlyr(impact_stack)) { # i = 1
  # Extract the current layer
  current_layer <- impact_stack[[i]]
  
  # Compute the sum for each region using the ID raster
  zonal_sum <- zonal(current_layer, eez, fun = "sum", na.rm=TRUE)
  
  # Add the result to the list
  result_list[[i]] <- zonal_sum
}

# Merge all data frames by region ID
eez_impact_result <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "rgn_id"), result_list)

eez_impact_result <- eez_impact_result %>%
 pivot_longer(cols=-rgn_id, names_to = "impact", values_to="value")

eez_impact_result <- eez_impact_result %>%
  left_join(eez_id, by="rgn_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(rgn_label)) %>%
   filter(rgn_label != "disputed")

# get number of cells in each eez:
 eez_cell_num <- zonal(ifel(eez>0, 1, 0), eez, fun = "sum", na.rm=TRUE)
 names(eez_cell_num) <- c("rgn_id", "cells")

dim(eez_impact_result)
eez_impact_result <- eez_impact_result %>%
  left_join(eez_cell_num, by="rgn_id") %>%
  mutate(region = "eez") 


write_csv(eez_impact_result, here("impact/data/country_eez_impact.csv"))

```


cumulative impact: country coastal region 
```{r}

country_coast <- rast(here("_spatial/coastal_country_mol.tif"))


eez_id <- read_csv(here("_spatial/eez_rgn_names/rgn_names_ohi.csv")) %>%
  filter(!(iso3c %in% "GUM")) # cut out duplicated dual region

impact_files <- list.files("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/impacts/cumulative", full=TRUE)

impact_stack <- rast(impact_files)
source_info <- gsub(".tif", "", basename(sources(impact_stack)))
names(impact_stack) <- source_info

result_list <- list()

# Loop through each layer in the cumulative stack
for (i in 1:nlyr(impact_stack)) { # i = 1
  # Extract the current layer
  current_layer <- impact_stack[[i]]
  
  # Compute the sum for each region using the ID raster
  zonal_sum <- zonal(current_layer, country_coast, fun = "sum", na.rm=TRUE)
  
  # Add the result to the list
  result_list[[i]] <- zonal_sum
}

# Merge all data frames by region ID
coast_impact_result <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "rgn_id"), result_list)

coast_impact_result <- coast_impact_result %>%
 pivot_longer(cols=-rgn_id, names_to = "impact", values_to="value")


coast_impact_result <- coast_impact_result %>%
  left_join(eez_id, by="rgn_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(rgn_label)) %>%
   filter(rgn_label != "disputed")

# get number of cells in each eez:
coast_cell_num <- zonal(ifel(country_coast>0, 1, 0), country_coast, fun = "sum", na.rm=TRUE)
 names(coast_cell_num) <- c("rgn_id", "cells")

dim(coast_impact_result)
coast_impact_result <- coast_impact_result %>%
  left_join(coast_cell_num, by="rgn_id") %>%
  mutate(region = "coast") 


```

plot dependence vs. impacts
```{r}
#from paper_statistics_v2
depend <- read_csv(here("impact/data/selig_marine_dependence.csv"))

impact_country <- coast_impact_result %>%
  mutate(avg_value = value/cells) 
#%>%
#  separate(impact, into = c("scenario", "time_period"), sep = "_")

impact_country <- impact_country %>%
  dplyr::select(region, rgn_label, iso3c, impact, avg_value) %>%
    pivot_wider(
    names_from = impact,
    values_from = avg_value
  )

impact_country$iso3c <- countrycode::countrycode(impact_country$rgn_label, "country.name", "iso3c") 
impact_country <- filter(impact_country, rgn_label != "Bassas da India")


double_rgns <- data.frame(rgn_label = c("Guadeloupe and Martinique", "Guadeloupe and Martinique",
              "Northern Mariana Islands and Guam", "Northern Mariana Islands and Guam",
              "Puerto Rico and Virgin Islands of the United States", "Puerto Rico and Virgin Islands of the United States"),
                 iso3c = c("GLP", "MTQ", "GUM", "MNP", "PRI", "VIR"))

coastal_double_eez <- filter(impact_country, rgn_label %in% c("Guadeloupe and Martinique",
                                               "Northern Mariana Islands and Guam",
                                               "Puerto Rico and Virgin Islands of the United States")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-iso3c)

coastal_double_eez2 <- left_join(double_rgns, coastal_double_eez, by="rgn_label")

impact_country <- filter(impact_country, !(rgn_label %in% c("Guadeloupe and Martinique",
                                               "Northern Mariana Islands and Guam",
                                               "Puerto Rico and Virgin Islands of the United States")))

coastal_eez_impact <- rbind(impact_country, coastal_double_eez2)
coastal_eez_impact$iso3c[coastal_eez_impact$rgn_label=="Northern Saint-Martin"] <- "NSM"
coastal_eez_impact$iso3c[coastal_eez_impact$rgn_label=="Micronesia"] <- "FSM"
coastal_eez_impact$iso3c[coastal_eez_impact$rgn_label %in% c("Crozet Islands",
                                       "Kerguelen Islands",
                                       "Amsterdam Island and Saint Paul Island",
                                       "Ile Europa",
                                       "Ile Tromelin",
                                       "Juan de Nova Island",
                                       "Glorioso Islands")] <- "ATF"
coastal_eez_impact <- filter(coastal_eez_impact, iso3c != "ATF")

coastal_eez_impact2 <- coastal_eez_impact %>%
  filter(!is.na(iso3c)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-rgn_label)


missing_iso3c <- setdiff(depend$iso3c, coastal_eez_impact2$iso3c)
filter(depend, iso3c %in% missing_iso3c) %>% print(n=25)
setdiff(coastal_eez_impact2$iso3c, depend$iso3c)

coastal_compare <- coastal_eez_impact2 %>%
  filter(region=="coast") %>%
  left_join(depend, by="iso3c") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ssp585_current))

coastal_compare <- coastal_compare %>%
  mutate(change_ssp245_medium = `ssp245_medium-term` - ssp245_current) %>%
    mutate(change_ssp585_medium = `ssp585_medium-term` - ssp585_current) %>%
  dplyr::select(region, iso3c, ssp245_current, `ssp245_medium-term`, change_ssp245_medium, ssp585_current, `ssp585_medium-term`, change_ssp585_medium, marine_dependence = integrated_depend)

rgn_names <- read_csv("_spatial/eez_rgn_names/rgn_names_ohi.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(rgn_label, iso3c)

coastal_compare <- left_join(coastal_compare, rgn_names, by="iso3c") %>%
  dplyr::select(region, iso3c, region_name = rgn_label,  ssp245_current, `ssp245_medium-term`, change_ssp245_medium, ssp585_current, `ssp585_medium-term`, change_ssp585_medium, marine_dependence)


write_csv(coastal_compare, here("impact/data/country_coast_cumulative_impact.csv"))
write_csv(coastal_compare, here("impact/data/dataS3.csv"))


coastal_compare <- read_csv(here("impact/data/country_coast_cumulative_impact.csv")) 

quants <- c(-Inf, quantile(coastal_compare$marine_dependence, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8), na.rm=TRUE), Inf)

coastal_compare <- coastal_compare %>%
  mutate(
    integrated_depend_category = cut(
     marine_dependence,
      breaks = quants,
      labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(data=coastal_compare , aes(y=`ssp245_medium-term`, x=change_ssp245_medium)) +
  geom_point(aes(text=region_name), alpha=0.7, size = 1.5, color="gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(coastal_compare$change_ssp245_medium, na.rm=TRUE), linetype="dashed", color="orange") +
   geom_hline(yintercept = median(coastal_compare$`ssp245_medium-term`, na.rm=TRUE), linetype="dashed", color="orange") +
  theme_classic()  +
  theme(
    # Add major gridlines
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "lightgray", size = 0.1),
    # Remove minor gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(y="Future impact", x = "\u0394 impact")
p
ggsave(here("impact/figs/current_future_scatterplot.png"), plot = p, width = 5, height = 3, dpi = 300)


## color version, not currently used
```
